record_verbatim.evidence: Validator finding verbatim: 'safety requirement has no verifies/validates link'. Measured against the registry: Link census measured on the registry: verifies links run TMS->FSR (15), TMS->SWR (10), TMS->TSR (7); validates links run TMS->SCO (1), TMS->SGO (1). In the corpus's own convention a test measure is the SOURCE and the requirement is the TARGET, so a well-verified requirement appears as a link TARGET, never as a source. FB2-SAF-SEC-000003 in profile synthetic_reference is neither the SOURCE nor the TARGET of any verifies or validates link anywhere in the corpus. No test measure in the corpus references any FB2-SAF-SEC-* artifact. The requirement itself declares verification_status 'not_verified', and it specifies acceptance criteria that have no measure, execution or evidence behind them.
record_verbatim.impact: This is a real and open verification gap, not a rule artefact. Five security requirements - authenticated transport, bounded connection admission, CAN message integrity and freshness, serial-link framing and authorisation, and strong entropy plus component governance - carry the entire cybersecurity concept and none of them is verified by anything in the corpus. The security case in this corpus therefore rests on requirements that have no verification evidence at all, and the acceptance criteria that would make them verifiable were written but never turned into a measure.

record_verbatim.resolution:
RESOLVED, and the premise under which this sprint re-examined it is corrected on the record. The hypothesis was that the five security requirements carry no verifies or validates link in either direction and are therefore genuinely unverified. That is false: all five are the target of a verifies link authored before this record was raised, and the validator correctly reports nothing because there is nothing to report.

WHAT FIXED IT. The measures and their links, which this record's own resolution said did not exist. FB2-VER-TMS-000018 was authored for FB2-SAF-SEC-000003 and linked by FB2-LNK-SEC-000081 with relation_type 'verifies' in docs/artifacts/traceability/link-registry/synthetic_reference/links-concept-lifecycle.json. Each measure carries an oracle_detail block declaring the oracle's kind and why that oracle is the right one for the requirement rather than borrowed from elsewhere; the kinds in use across the five are source_grounded, analytical_model and, for FB2-VER-TMS-000018, synthetic_assumption - that last one recorded honestly rather than hidden, because unpredictability of an initial sequence number is not observable from outside the implementation. The rule correction recorded as FB2-REV-FND-000029 was the second necessary part: without it the correctly directed links could not clear the finding, which is precisely the situation this record's own impact field described and could not fix.

EVIDENCE, re-derived on 2026-09-30T00:00:00Z: FB2-SAF-SEC-000003 appears as the target of 1 verifies link(s) and as the source of 0. The counterfactual was also run and is worth recording, because it is what turns 'there is a link' into 'the rule is looking at the right thing': with those 1 link(s) removed from an in-memory copy of the registries, the rule reports all five security requirements as unverified. The rule was never silent about them. See docs/artifacts/tests/rule_scope_probe.py.

RESIDUAL, and this is the part that matters: the LINK condition is resolved and the VERIFICATION condition is not. All five executions - FB2-VER-EXE-000016..000020 - carry execution_kind 'none' and outcome 'blocked', with a recorded blocked_reason that the security test harness for this corpus does not exist and that the requirement constrains a service the hypothetical project has planned but not built. FB2-SAF-SEC-000003.verification_status is therefore still 'not_verified', and that is correct. The security concept in this corpus is verification-PLANNED and not verification-ACHIEVED. This residual is now its own record, FB2-REV-FND-000041, rather than a sentence buried at the end of a resolved finding where it would be lost. human_approval_status remains pending, production_authorized remains false and product_verification_credit remains false. No human approved this revision, no tool is claimed to be qualified, and no certification, ISO 26262 conformity or ASPICE capability level is claimed or implied.
